ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixel background with approximately 12-15% coverage of high-intensity (white) localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular and annular blobs (diameter 5-15 pixels) distributed across both lobes. Significant spatial concentration on the superior-lateral margin of the left lobe and the medial-distal axis of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees and a vertical depth approximately 1/4 the height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary exhibiting frequent pixel-level oscillations (peaks and valleys) with amplitudes of 3-8 pixels; most pronounced along the distal margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe presents a broad convex curve transitioning to a jagged tip; right lobe follows a more linear, tapered trajectory from the notch to the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 40+ discrete high-contrast circular clusters (rosettes) across the surface. Primary constellation on the extreme upper-left tip and scattered clusters across the posterior central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring and barnacle colonization patterns across the entire visible ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the upper margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, contiguous white high-contrast mass forming a prominent cluster on the extreme superior-lateral corner of the left fluke lobe.
